# Allyson DeMerlis

::: {.tagline}
Marine Biologist · PhD Candidate
:::

Welcome! I am a marine biologist passionate about the resilience of reef-building corals in the face of anthropogenically induced climate change, mainly rising ocean temperatures. I study how corals respond to heat stress using transcriptomics, the study of gene expression patterns using bioinformatics.

I'm a PhD student at the University of Miami Rosenstiel School of Marine, Atmospheric, and Earth Science. I'm committed to open science: my code lives on [GitHub](https://github.com/ademerlis), and I keep a running [online lab notebook](https://ademerlis.github.io) of my analyses.
